介词 in / on / at:时间与地点: 时间上 at 接时刻、on 接具体某天、in 接年月季节;地点上 at 接小地点、on 接表面、in 接大地点或内部。

时间:at + 时刻(at seven, at noon, at night)|时间:on + 具体某天或某天的上午下午(on Monday, on May 1st)|时间:in + 年、月、季节、上午下午晚上(in 2026, in May, in spring, in the morning)|地点:at + 小地点(at the bus stop, at home, at school)|地点:on + 表面、街道(on the table, on the wall)|地点:in + 大地点、内部(in Beijing, in the box, in the classroom)
We have an English class at eight o'clock.
The keys are in the box on the table.
